NAME: Spin Finish
NOTES: Points for a spin finish. Stadium first-to-7 points are unchanged.

NAME: Over Finish
NOTES: Points for an Over finish.

NAME: Xtreme Finish
NOTES: Points for an Xtreme finish.

NAME: Big Impact
NOTES: +50 per heavy clash that deals at least this HUD RPM to the opponent.

NAME: Big Impact min HUD
NOTES: Minimum outgoing HUD RPM on a heavy clash to count as a Big Impact.

NAME: RPM band 1 end
NOTES: First this much HUD RPM damage uses band 1. Max match damage ~700 (100×7).

NAME: RPM band 1 per
NOTES: HUD RPM per point in band 1 (0–250).

NAME: RPM band 2 end
NOTES: Band 2 covers damage from band1 to this.

NAME: RPM band 2 per
NOTES: HUD RPM per point in band 2 (250–500). Denser than band 1.

NAME: RPM band 3 per
NOTES: HUD RPM per point above 500 toward the ~700 ceiling. Densest band.

NAME: Ability
NOTES: Ability damage uses RPM bands. Restore uses ABILITY_RESTORE_PER. Ability-caused Over/Xtreme add pocket bonuses.
COMMENT: Damage kits + Hurricane restore + ability Over/Xtreme.

NAME: Ability restore per
NOTES: HUD restore RPM per ability point (Hurricane +10 → 5 pts at 2).

NAME: Ability Over pocket
NOTES: Bonus on the Ability line when an ability knock pockets Over.

NAME: Ability Xtreme pocket
NOTES: Bonus on the Ability line when an ability knock pockets Xtreme.

NAME: Ability credit window
NOTES: How long after an ability shove/hit a pocket still counts as ability-caused.

NAME: HUD RPM scale
NOTES: Internal 0–1 RPM × this for display and damage totals.

NAME: Multiplier normal
NOTES: No scoring sequence.

NAME: Multiplier strong
NOTES: Big Impact → Finish or X-Rail → Finish.

NAME: Multiplier exceptional
NOTES: Big Impact → X-Rail → Finish. Elite 2.00 needs that Xtreme chain twice.

NAME: Multiplier elite
NOTES: Very rare: Big Impact → X-Rail → Xtreme twice in one match.

NAME: Bronze boss
NOTES: Rogue match 6 win bonus. Not a Quick Play score.

NAME: Silver boss
NOTES: Rogue match 12 win bonus.

NAME: Gold boss
NOTES: Reserved. No Gold mini-boss match yet.

NAME: Final boss
NOTES: Rogue match 18 win bonus.

NAME: Dashes
NOTES: Tracked on the summary. Always +0 pts.

NAME: X-Rail Rides
NOTES: Count of rail hooks. Always +0 pts.

NAME: Game Quality
NOTES: Horrible / Bad / Okay / Good / Perfect from player result and points scored.
